== Source, printing and text-state verification (Story 386) ==
The [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-world-championship-casey-anis-ls-hitco/ published Players Committee decklist] was compared with the [[Media:26Worlds Anis LS HITCO.txt|wiki-hosted XML download]] and the card articles linked in the table. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261114020530/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2026-world-championship-casey-anis-ls-hitco.html Players Committee decklist]. The download's File page attributes the XML to the forum distribution; the original forum ZIP has not been independently byte-verified.
The download contains 60 constructed-card entries. Its SHA-256 is <code>ec139d740af82bb9d8b66dfb628fa1e6a58bc68137f58c5c7edd4957dac8195e</code>; the download bytes were retained. The article lists 60 constructed cards and 24 outside-deck cards. Each outside-deck XML identity is counted separately; a card outside the deck is placed in its own card-type group when it is not a Defensive Shield.

=== Printing choices ===
* 1x [[Captain Hera Syndulla (ALT) (Errata 3)]]: XML <nowiki>204_3^</nowiki>. The explicit XML image variant is represented by the existing ALT article and its matching published image.
* 1x [[Dagobah: Yoda's Hut (V) (ALT) (Errata 2)]]: XML <nowiki>216_26^</nowiki>. The explicit XML image variant is represented by the existing ALT article and its matching published image.
